title: Grantex tool manifest 0.6
description: Declares, for one connector, the permission each tool requires and the optional purpose, cap, cost and decision constraints that enforce() applies to calls of that tool. See spec/manifest-0.6.md.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema. Ignored by loaders.

connector.description: Connector name. Appears in scopes as tool:<connector>:<permission>.

version.description: Version of this manifest (not of the schema). Defaults to 1.0.0.

propertyNames.description: cost_units is reserved: grant caps use it for the cost-unit budget.

permission.description: Required permission level. admin > delete > write > read.

purposePattern.description: A purpose (aml.cdd.onboarding), a prefix-segment wildcard (aml.cdd.*) or a private term (x-<org>.<term>, x-<org>.*).

allowed_purposes.description: The grant's purpose must match at least one pattern. Omit to apply no purpose restriction.

caps.description: Call caps. per_hour and per_day are rolling windows; per_case counts calls within one case. A cap of 0 disables the tool.

cost_units.description: Cost units charged against a grant's cost-unit budget, by component (for example base, ownership).

requires_decision.description: When true, a call also needs a decision grant. Not allowed on read tools.

four_eyes_on.description: Decision values that need two decision grants from different approvers. Requires requires_decision: true.
